A '''male Jedi Knight''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], becoming a key member of the [[Vaklin insurgency]] at the start of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], this being was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], studying under the tutelage of a [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Shrokaan)|Jedi Master]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Serving the Order during the war as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and later achieving the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], he avoided execution during the [[Order 66/Legends|initial stages]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] ascent to power and went into hiding with his former master on [[Vaklin]] alongside Jedi Master [[Cho'na Bene]].<ref name="TTF1" />

A key member of the [[Vaklin insurgency]], he watched in horror as his former master was dumped out an airlock over [[Shrokaan]] by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] after the Master had surrendered and been taken prisoner. The Knight was taken prisoner as well and repeatedly interrogated by Vader, who claimed that he should never have been made a Knight. During an interrogation session, Vader used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to constrict the Jedi's heart, forcing him to reveal that Bene had holed up in the [[Temple of Imperfect Repose]]. Moments later, a band of insurgents bent on freeing the Jedi broke into the detention facility, only to be struck down by Vader and a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The Jedi managed to free himself from his restraints, but without his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] he was easily [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Sith Lord.<ref name="TTF1" />
